text:
zoe_sales: Hey team — Cobalt wants to migrate from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a short POC to validate endpoint parity, get a cost delta, and run their security questionnaire. @raj_se can you lead the tech side?

raj_se: I can. Quick asks: 1) a scrubbed top-50 prompt set, 2) 3 representative traces, 3) which endpoints are heavy in prod (chat vs completions vs generate). Also need peak RPS and average token lengths to size the harness.

tom_cobalt: We'll share a JSONL with 55 prompts and two traces. Primary endpoints are /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Peak is ~240 rps during spikes, steady 45 rps. Sending artifacts to jd@cobalt.io.

infra-bot: staging org created: cobalt-poc-stg (keys expire in 8 days).

raj_se: POC sketch: Day 0 - onboarding + keys + IP allowlist. Day 1 - mapping + 500 side-by-side smoke samples. Day 2 - prompt-parity eval and regression set. Day 3 - perf tuning (batching + KV caching) and cost comparison. Deliverables: mapping doc, parity report (diff samples), and a 1-page cost delta.

maria_sec: Security checklist: they requested SOC2 scope confirmation, KMS/HSM options, data residency details, and a copy of our retention policy during POC. We need their completed questionnaire and architecture diagram. Turnaround estimate ~48-72h after we receive docs. Send to security@redwood.com and cc this thread.

ida_product: Mapping note: CompetitorX "swift-gen" maps to rwd-fast-1; "dialog-pro" maps to chat-rt. There are known stop-token and system-message stitching differences. For the POC harness we'll add a small prompt-normalization pass and canonicalize system messages to reduce spurious diffs. We'll also capture 100 representative diffs for product review.

raj_se: Quick smoke example to include so their engineers can validate connectivity: 
```
# CompetitorX example
POST https://api.competitorx.com/v1/generate
{ "prompt": "List action items:\n1. Review PR\n2. Ship release", "max_tokens": 100 }
# Redwood equivalent
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"input":"List action items:\n1. Review PR\n2. Ship release","max_tokens":100}'
```
Include that in the POC pack.

tom_cobalt: Procurement timeline: need draft SOW + pricing bands by next Wednesday. Security will start questionnaire Tuesday. Also want explicit language around log retention and data deletion after POC.

zoe_sales: Pricing ballpark: hosted commit discounts ~25% for 6mo, ~35% for 12mo depending on volume. Dedicated/reserved capacity quoted separately. I'll produce a SOW stub and run the discount bands with finance.

ida_product: Operational fallback suggestion: enable a quantized 8-bit variant under overload and log a sample bucket of responses to the parity monitor. Also apply a deterministic stop-token post-processing step in the harness. Add to SOW appendix.

raj_se: Action items: I'll post a 1-page POC plan + model mapping doc by EOD tomorrow. Maria will confirm security turnaround and send the questionnaire link. Infra will share IP allowlist and connection details. Zoe will draft SOW/pricing. Sync Friday 11am PT.

maria_sec: Note: if any traces contain PII they must be redacted before upload. We can offer a temporary KMS binding for test keys and a 14-day log retention for the POC if Cobalt agrees.

tom_cobalt: Confirmed procurement contact: procurement@cobalt.io, security contact: sec-lead@cobalt.io. We'll aim to get the questionnaire back within 48 hours.

zoe_sales: Thanks everyone 1 tagging @raj_se @maria_sec @infra-bot. Will send calendar invite and SOW stub. :thumbsup:

(reacts: :rocket:, :eyes:)
